name: Baro
source:
"What is it that you want? I have much wealth to share. I can buy anything for you."

A devil rich enough, but still greedy on the inside. His greed turns to the bride.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=kr.co.studiolumiere.devilspropose]English Google Play[/url]]
